gameSystem.readme:
For more info: https://boardgamegeek.com/boardgame/249299/f28

Game system files is based of the first revised edition, first print of F28 (F28 F28 1RE1P) and the first edition, first print of the Players Guide (PG 1ED1P).

If you are looking for the BattleScribe files for the first edtion, you can download it here: http://greyport.net/f28/f28_bs_1ed3p.zip

Battle: The faction lists are created for Battle with the force generation rules on page 74 in the rulebook. Force generation rules is in the readme for each faction.

Platoon vs Platoon: Is under development and might not work very well.

Skirmishes - War Always Changes: Is updated with thye first revised edition. Force creation rules is in the readme for Skirmishes.

Narrative: Is under development.

Factions lists, revised edition (F28 1RE1P and PG 1RE1P):
The Army of Republic(s)

The Mutant Menace

sharedRules.name: Infiltrate
sharedRules.description: Unit may deploy anywhere on table during the first initiative phase of the game, beyond 12” of enemy units and board edge(s), in reverse initiative order. If it does, the unit has scoring(no) turns 1-2.

sharedRules.name: Insertion
sharedRules.description: When in staging, this unit may deploy anywhere on the board beyond 2” of enemy units, as a full action. On the turn it does, it has Scoring(no).

sharedRules.name: Smokescreen
sharedRules.description: Deploy when activating for any action except Triple Move. Unit and any passengers has Target(potshots) and hit(potshots) until end of turn. One use.

sharedRules.name: Dual Weapon
sharedRules.description: Weapon has hit(re-roll). If it already has (or recieves), it gets Attack(x2) instead and loses hit(re-roll).

sharedRules.name: Inaccurate
sharedRules.description: Attacks with this model has hit(-1). Multiple sources of inaccurate does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Move(jump)
sharedRules.description: One (1) move each turn gets distance 12” and ignores (most) terrain.

sharedRules.description: Ignore terrain when moving, enemies may only trace line of sight to where the unit starts or ends up during activation.

sharedRules.description: Move one (1) extra move when taking the double move action.

sharedRules.name: Move(nimble)
sharedRules.description: No movement penalty for difficult terrain.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Ignore Suppression
sharedRules.description: All models in attached unit gains ability: Unit does not receive action markers from suppression

sharedRules.name: Massive
sharedRules.description:
Model no longer counts as regular. Cover(no). Model does not suffer a penalty for attacking with heavy weapons without priority.
Attacks vs Massive models within 2” of regular models become inaccurate instead of potshots from the intermingled rule.
Massive models within 2” of regular models attack targets beyond 2” with inaccurate instead of potshots from the Close Quarters rule.
Model’s unarmed attack is CC (2), hit(-2), wound(+2).
Model is not automatically wounded on rolls of ‘6’, instead add +1 to the wound roll for
each ‘6’ discarded. requiring two ‘6’s for 7, three for 8, etc.

sharedRules.name: Bestow Loathing
sharedRules.description: All models in this model’s unit have Loathing: Re-roll results of ‘1’ to wound for this model.

sharedRules.name: Scanner
sharedRules.description: Model has Interdiction(2, 15”) vs units that deploy with Insertion or Ambush.

sharedRules.name: Insertion Beacon
sharedRules.description: One (1) friendly unit (per turn) deploying with insertion within 12” of this model arrives with one (1) less action marker.

sharedRules.name: Accurate
sharedRules.description: Attacks with this model has hit(+1). Multiple sources of Accurate does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Vanguard
sharedRules.description: In the first initiative phase of the game (reverse initiative order, after any Infiltrate deployment) this model may make a 12” move from staging.

sharedRules.name: Faction Points
sharedRules.description:
Players get 1 Faction Point per full 300 points of game size, and can spend them during force generation to exceed the limits above. Spend one (1) FP to take:
● One (1) extra Command entry, to a maximum of two (2)
● One (1) extra Special entry 
● Two (2) additional upgrades

sharedRules.name: Bestow Morale(level)
sharedRules.description: All models in this model’s unit have Morale(level): Unit removes level extra action markers in endphase, as long as all models in unit has at least this level of Morale.

sharedRules.name: Medical Support
sharedRules.description: Ignore the first wound suffered by this unit from attacks each turn.

sharedRules.name: Assassin
sharedRules.description: Attacker may target individual models (instead of units). Any suppression caused is still applied to the unit as a whole. The Medical Support trait may not be used to cancel wounds from this model.

sharedRules.name: Extra Strike
sharedRules.description: Model has number extra attack dice with CC attacks.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle Repair
sharedRules.description: Remove a total of 1 additional action marker from vehicle units within 12” in the endphase, even if vehicle is damaged.

sharedRules.name: Mystic Weapon
sharedRules.description: Add Mystic level attack dice to the weapon’s attack, but gain Hazardous.

sharedRules.name: Mystic(school level)
sharedRules.description:
When attacking, you may roll level number of dice and pick one (1) power from the school list of power level equal or less than the highest dice rolled.

If you roll doubles, you may use the boosted version of a power at the same level.
In addition, apply any result of one or more ‘1’.

sharedRules.description: AT(+D6). When rolling on the vehicle damage table from wounds from this weapon, roll two dice and keep the highest. Damage(2) vs non-vehicles.

sharedRules.name: Hazardous
sharedRules.description: Model using weapon suffers 1 wound(min 6) hit for each ‘1’ on the to hit roll.

sharedRules.name: Heavy
sharedRules.description: Unless mounted on a vehicle or massive model, non-priority attacks are potshots. Priority attacks are Accurate.

sharedRules.name: Pistol

sharedRules.name: Suppression(x2)

sharedRules.name: VTOL
sharedRules.description:
Target(min 5) or Target(5) vs attacks with antiair. Move(flight). CC(no). Never starts the game deployed on the board.
Passengers forced to disembark a destroyed VTOL take a wound(min 6) hit for each wound instead of a dangerous terrain test.
May not be the target of non-VTOL CC attacks or ranged attacks with 12” or less range.
Weapons on VTOL do not become accurate from the heavy trait.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle(walker)
sharedRules.description: Ignore (most) difficult/dangerous terrain10.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle(wheeled)
sharedRules.description: Roll on the damage table with -2 when entering dangerous terrain.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle(hover)
sharedRules.description: Ignores (most) terrain when moving.

sharedRules.name: Aircraft
sharedRules.description:
Target(min 6) or Target(6) vs attacks with antiair. Move(flight). CC(no). Never starts the game deployed on the board.
Returns to staging in endphase.
If activated in staging with a single action marker, you may still perform a full action on 4+, and recieves only 1 action marker.
inaccurate vs ground targets.
Passengers forced to disembark a destroyed aircraft take a wound(min 6) hit for each
wound instead of a dangerous terrain test.
May not be the target of weapons that have less than two (2) attack dice or 24” or less range unless they are mounted on aircraft.
Weapons on Aircraft do not become accurate from the heavy trait.

sharedRules.description: Model no longer counts as regular. Move(9). Additional rules in the “Vehicles” section of the core rules.

sharedRules.name: Vehicle(open)
sharedRules.description: +1 on damage table, all passengers may fire out of, may use vehicle move for CC attack.

sharedRules.description: Model no longer counts as regular. Move(9). Additional rules in the “Vehicles” section of the core rules. Model is destroyed by any positive result on the vehicle damage table. All other results have no effect

sharedRules.name: Antiair
sharedRules.description: May attack Aircraft and VTOL despite lack of attack dice or range. Aircraft have Target(6) and VTOL have Target(5) vs antiair attacks. Accurate vs Aircraft and VTOL.

sharedRules.name: Priority(only)

sharedRules.name: Indirect(modifier)
sharedRules.description: Weapon may attack without line of sight with hit(modifier), unless otherwise specified. If any model in the same unit as the attacker has line of sight to the target, ignore the modifier.

sharedRules.name: Concealment
sharedRules.description: Target(+1) vs ranged attacks. Multiple sources of Concealment does not stack.

sharedRules.name: Defence(x)
sharedRules.description:
A roll of X or more is required to wound this model.
X/Y: model has Defence X vs ranged attacks coming from in front of the model and Y otherwise (see vehicles section).
max/min X: to wound is never worse/better than X+. (in case of conflict with similar ruling on an attack, Defence takes precedence unless specifically mentioned)
xY: Y successful rolls required to cause one (1) wound. example: defence(6x2) – two ‘6’ required
re-roll: you may force opponent to re-roll any wound roll dice versus this model. For purposes of attacking a mixed unit, defence(x, re-roll) is considered better than defence(x).

sharedRules.name: Laser Marker
sharedRules.description:
48” (1), on hit add one (1) lock token to the target. Discard 1+ lock token to give a 5p ranged attack of one (1) friendly unit versus the target:
• Masterwork
• Replace Masterwork with hit(re-roll)
• Ignore Concealment
• Lose any indirect penalty
• Lose inaccurate
• Attack with any 1 Laser-guided missile in range as a free action. The attack
replaces hit(potshots) with indirect and hit(auto).

Discard all lock tokens when target moves. Laser markers do not benefit from lock tokens. You may execute Laser marker attacks before other friendly weapons in the same attack.

sharedRules.description: Use max 1/turn when an attack versus an enemy unit within los suffers an indirect penalty OR inaccurate vs ground targets (see Aircraft). The attack loses these penalties.

sharedRules.name: Exfiltrate

sharedRules.name: Superior withdrawal
sharedRules.description: As long as every model in the unit has this trait, it can always make a withdrawal move in the endphase and gains no additional action markers from withdrawal moves.

sharedRules.name: Explosive Tip
sharedRules.description: CC (1), wound +5, one use

sharedRules.name: Cleave

sharedRules.name: Attack(modifier)
sharedRules.description: Attack dice for this model is modified by modifier. This only includes the model’s original attacks, and not those granted by Mystic powers, Faction powers, upgrades and the like. Additionally, it does not apply to one use attacks.

sharedRules.name: Disruption(distance)

sharedRules.description: For every action marker you would allocate from suppression to a unit with one or more models with this trait, the unit instead suffers one (1) wound. This wound has to be allocated to a model with this trait. Use of the trait is optional.

sharedRules.name: Fanatic
sharedRules.description: For every action marker you would allocate from suppression to a unit with one or more models with this trait, the unit instead suffers one (1) wound. This wound has to be allocated to a model with this trait.

● Model may not be allocated action markers from sources other than attacks.
● Model does not roll on the damage table for other reasons than losing its last wound.
● Model may not be moved by outside effects.
● Model is not affected by bestow, cause or inflict.
